title: Concrete Sublow
description: A thick detuned REESE that prowls the sub register, gated by a stepped tremolo that syncopates the groove while a saw-LFO filter wobble chews the low end. Drive and detune drift thicken the timbre as tape-style dub delays throw fragments out into the dark, the whole arc breathing over 16 cycles.
code:
setcpm(70/4)
stack(
  note("<f1 f1 ab1 c2 f1 ab1 c2 db2>*4").s("supersaw")
    .unison(5)
    .detune(saw.slow(23).range(0.18, 0.42))
    .tremolosync("<4 8 8 16 4 16>/8")
    .tremolodepth(saw.slow(13).range(0.55, 0.9))
    .tremoloshape("square")
    .lpf(saw.slow(11).range(180, 1400))
    .resonance(perlin.slow(29).range(8, 18))
    .ftype("ladder")
    .shape(square.slow(16).range(0.35, 0.72))
    .distort(perlin.slow(17).range(0.2, 0.65))
    .hpf(45)
    .delay("0.55:0.375:0.78")
    .delaytime("<0.375 0.5 0.375 0.25>/8")
    .delayfeedback(0.72)
    .orbit(2)
    .gain(0.95)
)
